content.short: Steakhouse Financial is a leading DeFi advisory firm specializing in institutional risk curation.
content.description: Steakhouse Financial is a premier decentralized finance advisory and risk management firm that provides institutional-grade digital asset solutions. They specialize in the curation and management of credit vaults and stablecoin liquidity on major protocols like Morpho and Sky. As key contributors to the RWA space, Steakhouse Financial bridges the gap between traditional finance and on-chain markets by onboarding real-world credit and treasuries into the DeFi ecosystem with a focus on transparency and rigorous risk analysis. Their expertise helps protocols maintain high safety standards for institutional and retail users alike.
